patch_description: The current program uses Z-axis triple interactions (ZZZ) for all eight winning lines. This new candidate diversifies the interaction axes by alternating between ZZZ (MultiRZ) and CCRZ (doubly-controlled RZ) motifs across different geometric groups. Specifically, it applies ZZZ to the horizontal rows and diagonals, while utilizing CCRZ for the vertical columns to capture higher-order conditional correlations. Additionally, it introduces a 'mixing' layer of CNOTs on the grid edges to improve state distribution before the final symmetry-grouped RX/RZ rotations. This approach aims to increase the expressivity of the circuit by exploring different non-commuting basis interactions on the same winning-line motifs.
